title: Her Voice
text: {who} sits alone in the Civilian Center with the Director's briefing on a loop. "She was the first voice the pods played us. Before you. I used to think she sounded like home." The tape folds its hands and starts again.

choices.label: Turn it off
choices.reply: "Leave it," {who} says. "I want to hear it till it stops sounding like anything."

choices.label: Sit with them
choices.reply: You stay on the channel and say nothing, and the tape plays through to the end four more times.

notes: A colonist at home reacts by name once foundry is done (the discovery played back at home, v0.90.0).
